determinations.meaning: All in-scope audit requirements are satisfied with evidence.
Complete within scope while retained risks remain visible.
Only the named bounded scope is complete.
Some required evidence or review remains open.
Sufficient for a bounded next step but not full closure.
A required gate failed or required evidence is unavailable.
The scope did not assess this state.

evidence_classes.acceptance_rule: Every relied-upon source must be exact-byte identified or marked unavailable.
Command, environment, commit, result, and failure treatment required.
Certification may bound reliance but does not replace missing bytes unless expressly scoped.
Waiver permits exception only; it is not a passed test.
Pilot evidence is limited to cohort, duration, environment, and scope.
Certificate cannot include excluded lifecycle states.
